entities.name: NUPR1
observations: Also known as p8; the cited mouse study examined NUPR1/p8 deficiency.

entities.name: Acute pancreatitis
observations: Acute pancreatitis was experimentally induced with ceruletide/cerulein in the cited mouse study; abstract details the specific protocol are unavailable.

entities.name: PMID:25098696
observations: 2014 Pancreas paper: “p8 Deficiency causes siderosis in spleens and lymphocyte apoptosis in acute pancreatitis.” Compared p8/Nupr1 knockout mice with matched wild-type mice.

entities.name: Splenic siderosis in NUPR1 deficiency
observations: Mature p8/Nupr1 knockout mice showed splenic siderosis relative to matched wild-type mice; reported as a deficiency-associated phenotype.

entities.name: Lymphocyte apoptosis in pancreatitis
observations: During experimental acute pancreatitis, p8/Nupr1 knockout mice had greater CD3+ and CD3+CD4+ cell declines, white-pulp hypoplasia, and significantly increased splenic apoptosis versus wild type.
